blocks.content: Quick revision of core concepts and consistent practice are the keys to clearing RRB competitive examinations.

items: General Science questions in RRB exams are mostly derived from Class 9 and 10 NCERT fundamentals.
Pay attention to 1/3rd negative marking per incorrect answer in Computer Based Tests (CBT).
Current Affairs coverage strictly targets the major events of the preceding 6 to 12 months.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: RRB competitive examinations prioritize General Science, Mathematics, Reasoning, and General Awareness.
Thorough revision of fundamental formulas and definitions significantly improves speed and accuracy in CBT tests.
Solving previous years' question papers helps identify high-yield topics frequently asked by RRB.
Time management and accuracy are critical due to the negative marking penalty.
